summary: Phase A full-stack regression (OptiScreen). Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL (/app/backend/tests/test_phase_a.py). All Phase A APIs verified: /screener/profiles returns 3 numeric profiles + 13 strategies + 4 account types + defaults; /screener/best-options honors profile+period(day/week/month/custom)+sliders+account_size and returns filters/stats.rejected_by/results-with-liquidity-grade+collateral_by_account+expiration_days; warm-cache scan returns in <5s on repeat; /screener/find-stocks respects sector filter and maps legacy risk/reward -> profile high_high; /screener/ticker-options prices all 13 strategies on SPY, Short Strangle correctly disallowed in cash/ira (allowed=false), unknown strategy -> 400, auto returns legs/pricing(net_mid,net_fill,slippage_cost,fees)/volatility(iv,hv20,iv_rank)/liquidity.estimated=true/events/why/risks/alternatives/breakevens with max_loss<=0 or None; /screener/stock-analysis day+swing return trade_plan(direction,entry,stop,target,atr,shares,logic) + scenarios Bull/Base/Bear, long returns valuation+valuation_inputs; /screener/valuation recalculates (or 400 w/o EPS); /screener/explain returns summary+picks; alert validation: price_above w/o threshold -> 400, negative threshold -> 422, earnings w/o threshold -> 200. Frontend (mobile 390x844): login (trader@optiscreen.app) works and lands on Discover; profile-low_low|low_high|high_high cards + toggle-finetune (reveals sl-max-loss/sl-min-pop/sl-min-roc/sl-min-iv/sw-earnings) + disc-run + scan-stats + disc-result-{TICKER} all present and interactive. Tapping a result navigates to Analyze with Options Lab prefilled and auto-run. Options Lab shows all expected sections (Why this fits, What could go wrong, Realistic pricing, Collateral by account table with coll-cash/ira/reg_t/portfolio_margin rows, Volatility, Liquidity MODEL ESTIMATE badge, Events) and strategy chips (strat-Iron Condor etc.) + account chips (an-acct-cash etc.) work. Swing lab renders scen-Bull/Base/Bear + trade plan (entry/stop/target/ATR/shares/logic). Long-term lab exposes dcf-bull/base/bear/disc/tpe + dcf-recalc + weighted value + buy/sell zones. One unverified-via-screenshot item: PayoffChart renders on Covered Call result — the component is wired in analyze.tsx (line 259) via @/src/charts, but inner-ScrollView wouldn't scroll in headless Playwright so SVG count read 0 at viewport top; not reproducible as a bug, flagging as a self-check for main agent.
action_items: Optional self-check: verify PayoffChart (SVG) visually renders in the Options Lab result for Covered Call — code is wired (analyze.tsx:259) but Playwright inner-scroll could not expose it in automated viewport; manual check in Expo preview is enough.

Old /app/backend/tests/test_optiscreen_api.py expects legacy fields (premium, collateral, annual_pct_no_margin, ai_summary) that the new engine no longer returns on best-options/ticker-options. New Phase A suite (test_phase_a.py) supersedes it — recommend removing or rewriting the old file so CI doesn't trip on it.

engine.py:313-358 collateral_by_account correctly returns {allowed:false, reason:'Naked short options are not permitted...'} for Short Strangle in cash/ira and allowed=true for reg_t/portfolio_margin.
server.py:762-783 /alerts/add validates kind + threshold (400 when price alert lacks threshold); Pydantic Field(gt=0) catches negatives as 422. Earnings alerts correctly allow null threshold.
server.py:271-284 warm_universe_loop prefetches candles+quotes+earnings+metrics for the full UNIVERSE, respecting Polygon free-tier limits — explains the <2s warm scan latency measured in tests.
analyze.tsx:258-259 PayoffChart imported and rendered unconditionally for Options Lab results — correct for any strategy including Covered Call (has Stock leg).
screen.tsx:78 profile cards expose testID=`profile-${id}` for all three numeric profiles; screen.tsx:196 collateral table rows expose testID=`coll-${account_type}`.
